product.caption_latex: \textbf{Observed-test placement gains need not survive autonomous feedback.} Train rows and lower policy rows are mixed-minus-base effects; risk gaps are risk-minus-random, and their change is the mixed-minus-base interaction. Dots show paired seeds; diamonds and bars show mean $\pm$ sample seed SD, not confidence intervals. Scales differ. $\dagger$: a mixed Goop seed-2 guard leaves the three-seed mean undefined; defined seeds remain visible. NP: WaterDrop RMS was not predeclared. Observed risk scores the preceding observed base graph; autonomous risk caches its own preceding graph.

Triplets show seeds 0, 1, and 2 for each named contrast; negative means lower error or a smaller risk-minus-random gap. The cross retains Goop's undefined full-horizon interaction.
